newsitem.title: MEXICO: Six escape, two die in Mexico City jailbreak - radio.
newsitem.headline: Six escape, two die in Mexico City jailbreak - radio.

text.p: Two prisoners died during a jailbreak from a Mexico City prison late on Sunday and six inmates were still at large, according to radio reports.
Police officials told Radio Red three other people were injured in the escape from the Reclusorio del Oriente prison.
The jailbreak took place at about 7:30 p.m. (0130 GMT).
Officials at the prison were not immediately available for comment. No further details were available
